x: This season we hope to have Arthcr Allum, now fully recovered from his illness, up with his fellow-Internationals, Footer and Penny, with Carter and Flower on their heels, and the others not far away.

On leaving the starting field, the runners were bunched together, with Penny, Flower and Carter making the pace. At the Windmill, however, we had a surprise, for Penny had opened up a gap of 100 yards.
Penny, Allum, Footer, Flower, Carter and Taylor, upon their handsome win which has brought honour to the Club, and inspiration for those who follow.
Allum, Shaw and Flower have all scored for the Club in past National races, but we know their natural disappointment soon turned to joy at the Club's win.

Here Penny was leading Les Cohen by 39 secs., with Allum a further 20 secs. behind in third place. Williams, Taylor, Ring, Shields and Flower followed. Then came a batch of runners, led by our Captain, H.E.F.
Soon after this, Bert forged ahead to pass Carter, Flower came up from 10th position to 7th to displace Allum, and Shields dropped back a couple of places.
The Captain that day was Bert Footer and the rest of the team were Allum, Carter, Flower, Ginty, Parker, Patience; Shaw, Ring, Rice, Shields and Taylor.
